George Russell won the Azerbaijan Grand Prix from pole position and set the fastest lap. Red Bull achieved a double podium with Max Verstappen finishing second after climbing from eighth, while Isack Hadjar finished third. Ferrari's Charles Leclerc completed the podium behind them in fourth. The race also saw several retirements including Lando Norris, Alexander Albon, Pierre Gasly, Franco Colapinto, and both Aston Martin drivers.
highlights: George Russell took victory and the fastest lap from pole position.
Max Verstappen climbed from eighth to second place.
Lando Norris retired after starting fifth on the grid.
Both Aston Martin drivers failed to finish the race.

review.summary: Pedro Acosta won the Grand Prix of Austria for KTM, followed by Aprilia's Jorge Martin and Marco Bezzecchi on the podium. The classification shows a strong showing from Aprilia with two riders in the top three, alongside Ai Ogura in fourth. Ducati riders Marc Marquez and Francesco Bagnaia also finished in the top seven.
highlights: Pedro Acosta took the victory for Red Bull KTM Factory Racing.
Alex Marquez did not finish the race.
Ai Ogura secured fourth place for SuperFile Trackhouse MotoGP Team.
